rationale_highlights: Mr. Budd is also an intergenerational survivor and inheritor of the legacy of the residential school system as embodied by the absence of his father from his life

his blameworthiness is significantly reduced by the Gladue factors that apply and his long standing addiction issues which contributed to his offending behaviour
